messages:
Aisha K.: hey team — I accepted the org invite but GitHub still shows me as an Outside Collaborator and I can’t see private repos. I also got a popup about 'account merge required' when I clicked Accept. I have 2FA on my personal account only. I tried linking my work email to that account and now it’s prompting to merge. Not comfortable merging personal+work. Any guidance?

Sam (infra): hey @Aisha K. — that popup is the common GH behavior when the invite email differs from the primary email on your GH user. Quick options: 1) People Ops can resend invite to the email on your existing GH account, 2) link your work email to your GH account and accept SSO (may trigger merge flow), or 3) we provision a managed work account for you and send a fresh invite. Which do you prefer?

Aisha K.: attaching screenshot would've helped but can't here — invite subject is 'Redwood: invitation to join organization' and the Accept link lands on a GitHub page that asks to merge accounts. Also getting SSH errors when trying to clone:

    git clone git@github.com:redwood/infrastructure.git
    Cloning into 'infrastructure'...
    Permission denied (publickey).
    fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

I have an id_ed25519 key on my laptop, but maybe it's tied to personal account.

Ewa - IT: totally fine to avoid merging. If you want to keep your personal GH untouched we can: (a) have People Ops revoke current invite and resend to your personal GH email as external collaborator, OR (b) provision a managed work account (SSO) for you so it never touches your personal acct. Option (a) keeps you on your personal GH but might restrict access to some org-only repos. Option (b) is the clean enterprise flow. Which do you want?

People Ops: @Ewa - IT please hold on revoke until we hear from Aisha. @Aisha K. if you prefer managed account DM your preferred username and we'll create a Redwood-managed SSO account for you. Note: org policy requires 2FA on the account used to join.

Sam (infra): for the SSH problem double-check that your public key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) is added to whichever GH account you plan to use. Quick verification: ssh -T git@github.com should say 'Hi <username>!'. If it still fails paste your public key here (or DM) and we can add it temporarily to the managed account after it's created.

Aisha K.: my GH username is aishak — I’ll DM the public key. I’d prefer not to merge or touch my personal account, so managed account sounds best.

Ewa - IT: got it. People Ops will create the managed account and send an invite to your work email that ties into our SSO. After you accept and enable 2FA we can add your SSH key and grant team membership. FYI: some infra repos require explicit infra-readers access, we'll add that after accept.

People Ops: creating managed account now — you’ll get an email from no-reply@github.com with subject 'Redwood: invitation to join organization' and instructions. Accept, set a password, enable 2FA, then follow the account linking steps we send. Ping here if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: Reminder: org policy requires 2FA and an approved SSH public key before repo permissions are granted. Onboarding doc: https://redwood.example/handbook/onboarding/github-access

Aisha K.: thanks everyone — DMing username and key. Please proceed with the managed account path. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:

Sam (infra): noted. I’ll watch for the managed account and add you to infra-readers within ~1 hour after People Ops confirms invite acceptance.
